text:
julia: Quick idea: introduce a short-lived "lease token" for spot GPU nodes so a pod can hold a soft lock and avoid being flapped during market jitter.

sam: TL;DR: lease token to reduce rebinds/cache misses. 10-30m window. +1

rahul: Prob needs CA integration. If node is 'leased' we should extend scale-down and avoid draining until lease expires or node preempt notice.

kat: Think about cost — warm spares. Make leases opportunistic: only for long jobs or cache-warming scenarios.

julia: Sketch: controller grants lease -> annotate node spot.redwood/lease=active -> taint node spot.redwood/leased=true:NoSchedule -> only pods with toleration and the token can stay.

```
# node annotation
kubectl annotate node gpu-spot-17 spot.redwood/lease=active
# pod toleration
tolerations:
- key: "spot.redwood/lease"
  operator: "Equal"
  value: "active"
  effect: "NoSchedule"
```

sam: Controller responsibilities: grant, renew, revoke, expose prometheus metrics, and coordinate with CA flags (e.g., set cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/scale-down-disabled=true).

rahul: On preempt notice: controller sets lease.redwood/state=revoking and triggers pod checkpoint hook so jobs can persist progress. Also signal CA to not immediately replace capacity to avoid duplicate starts.

kat: Heuristics to grant:
- pod estimate runtime > 2m
- pod requests local cache or local-ssd
- node GPU utilization indicates warm cache
Lease length = min(30m, half of spot notice TTL)

sam: Add per-team token quota so one team can't hoard warm nodes. token bucket or credits per billing account.

rahul: Integration tests: simulate spot termination, ensure preStop/checkpoint runs and node revocation path clears annotations and taints.

kat: Ops runbook draft:
- Watch zone preempt rate; if >3/hr, throttle lease grants in that zone
- If cost delta > +12% month, reduce default TTL

julia: Metrics to track: lease_hits (how many preempts avoided), avg cache_warm_saved_secs, cost_delta_usd_hour, lease_denied_* reasons.

sam: I'll build a 2d spike PoC: controller that annotates nodes and flips the CA scale-down annotation. infra-sandbox deploy.

rahul: I'll add tests for preempt path and graveyard nodes.

kat: I'll model cost impact and ops thresholds.

infra-bot: deploy job queued: spike/lease-token-poc -> infra-sandbox (ETA 48h) :rocket:

julia: Thanks all. Schedule follow-up next Wed. :thumbsup:
